# Model Router

> Model Router (`model-router`) is an open-source Claude Code plugin that keeps the Claude model and reasoning effort Claude names for every agent Claude Code starts (subagents, agent-team teammates and workflow stages) inside the user's limits, sets the effort nobody named, and runs a call Claude marks as a redo with more effort or on a stronger model. It picks among Claude models only (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, Fable). It isn't a proxy to non-Claude models. An independent project by Cris Nahine (https://github.com/crisnahine), not made or endorsed by Anthropic. Apache-2.0 license. Needs Claude Code 2.1.329 or later and Python 3.9 or later. Site: https://crisnahine.github.io/claude-code-model-router/

Facts, each with its source:

- The ladder: lookup runs on Haiku at medium effort, standard on Sonnet at medium, complex on Opus at high, hardest on Opus at xhigh, frontier on Fable at high. A model named on a call stands for its lowest level and runs at that level's effort when nobody named one; Opus named with xhigh or max is hardest. The router never reads a brief. Source: plugins/model-router/config/models.json and docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
- Redo escalation: only a call whose description starts with "Redo:" is a redo, which Claude marks when a check failed or a result fell short. One that names its own model or effort runs as named. Otherwise it runs one effort step up on the model of the run it redoes while that run was below high, else on the next stronger model. Workflow stages are never redone. /model-router:usage counts redos by level. Source: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/GUIDE.md.
- Who decides the model, strongest first: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE, a model named on the call, a per-agent rule in model-router.json, the agent's own model field, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL, then the parent's model. The winner is held to the max_tier cap and raised to a rule's level. Source: docs/ARCHITECTURE.md.
- Benchmarks: the last run measured the routing code at commit 780ee86, before complex moved to Opus and the verify gate was turned on, so it doesn't price today's defaults. On an Opus 5.5 session the router solved 70 of 70 runs, as many as Claude Code's defaults, for $0.121 per solved task against the defaults' $0.151. It isn't the cheapest setup on these tasks: every subagent on Haiku at high effort also solved 70 of 70, for $0.075. On a Sonnet session the router cost more per solved task than the cheapest other setup in 6 of 8 task classes. Source: docs/BENCHMARKS.md and docs/TRACEABILITY.md row S4.15.
- Privacy: no prompt, brief, path or code leaves the machine. The only network traffic is a daily fetch from code.claude.com and platform.claude.com, and api.anthropic.com for the account's model list when an Anthropic API key is set. Source: docs/SECURITY.md.

## Docs

- [Site](https://crisnahine.github.io/claude-code-model-router/): the project page
- [Video](https://crisnahine.github.io/claude-code-model-router/assets/video.mp4): 22 seconds on four agent calls being routed and a redo climbing one level
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crisnahine/claude-code-model-router/main/README.md): what it does, install, options, compatibility
- [Questions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crisnahine/claude-code-model-router/main/docs/FAQ.md): short answers to common questions
- [Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crisnahine/claude-code-model-router/main/docs/GUIDE.md): commands, every option, who decides the model, workflows and ultracode, limits, providers, update and uninstall
- [Built on the docs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crisnahine/claude-code-model-router/main/docs/CLAUDE_CODE_DOCS.md): each Claude Code and Claude docs rule the plugin follows, with its doc page and test
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crisnahine/claude-code-model-router/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): the two paths, the ladder, the decision and its order of authority
- [Glossary](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crisnahine/claude-code-model-router/main/GLOSSARY.md): the project's own words
- [Benchmarks](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crisnahine/claude-code-model-router/main/docs/BENCHMARKS.md): cost per solved task against Claude Code without the plugin, with raw data
- [Security](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crisnahine/claude-code-model-router/main/docs/SECURITY.md): what reaches the network and who can influence routing
- [Performance](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/crisnahine/claude-code-model-router/main/docs/PERFORMANCE.md): hook latency, state size and the context the plugin adds
